==English== {{wp|}} ===Alternative forms=== * {{alt|en|respeck|resp'ct||eye dialect}} ===Etymology=== {{ety|en|id=noun|:inh|enm:respect>>>|tree=1}} {{ety|en|id=verb|:denominal|respect}} From {{inh|en|enm|respect}}, from {{der|en|fro|respect}}, also {{m|fro|respit||respect, regard, consideration}}, from {{der|en|la|respectus||a looking at, regard, respect}}, perfect passive participle of {{m|la|respiciō||look at, look back upon, respect}}, from {{m|la|re-||back}} + {{m|la|speciō||to see}}, equivalent to {{confix|en|re|spect}}. {{doublet|en|respite}}. The [[verb]] is derived from the [[noun]]. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈspɛkt/|a=RP,GA,CA}} ** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-respect.wav|a=Southern England}} ** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Wodencafe-respect.wav|a=Texas}} ** {{audio|en|LL-Q7976 (mis)-Le Rêveur0316-respect.wav|a=Western Pennsylvania}} * {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈspekt/|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|/ɹəˈspekt/|a=NZ}} * {{hyphenation|en|re|spect}} * {{rhymes|en|ɛkt|s=2}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun|~}} # {{lb|en|uncountable}} An attitude of consideration or high [[regard#Noun|regard]]; a feeling of [[admiration]] or [[esteem]]. #: {{syn|en|deference|esteem|consideration|regard|fealty|reverence|aught}} #: {{ux|en|He is an intellectual giant, and I have great '''respect''' for him.}} #* {{quote-web |en |date=October 15, 2022 |title=Tajik President's Demand For 'Respect' From Putin Viewed Millions Of Times On YouTube |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20221017142103/https://www.rferl.org/a/tajikistan-russia-rahmon-youtube-respect/32084773.html |archivedate=17 October 2022 |work=w:Radio Free Europe |text=A video of Tajik President Emomali Rahmon complaining to Russian President Vladimir Putin about his lack of '''respect''' for the countries of Central Asia that were once part of the Soviet Union has struck a nerve on social media, where it has been viewed millions of times.{{...}}
“We have always respected the interests of our main strategic partner,” Rahmon said, referring to Russia. “We want '''respect''', too."}} # {{lb|en|uncountable}} Good opinion, honor, or admiration. #: {{syn|en|admiration|esteem|reverence|regard|recognition|veneration|honor}} # {{lb|en|uncountable|always plural}} Polite [[greetings]], often offered as [[condolences]] after a death. #: {{ux|en|The mourners paid their last '''respects''' to the deceased poet.}} # {{lb|en|countable}} A particular [[aspect]], [[feature]] or [[detail]] of something. #: {{syn|en|aspect|dimension|face|facet|side}} #: {{ux|en|This year's model is superior to last year's in several '''respects'''.}} #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Sonnets|36|text=In our two loves there is but one '''respect'''}} # Good will; favor. #* {{RQ:KJV|Exodus|2|25|text=And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had '''respect''' unto them.}} ====Antonyms==== {{col4|en |belittlement |contempt |contumely |despect |disdain
